name: The Heart of Sorrow
summary: At the top of Castle Ravenloft's high tower hangs a crystal heart that takes Strahd's wounds before he does.

stages.journal: Something at the top of the high tower keeps Strahd standing: a heart of glass that beats for him and takes his wounds first. Break it, and he bleeds like anyone else.
objectives: Climb to the top of the high tower
stages.hint: Climb Castle Ravenloft's high tower to the very top.

stages.journal: At the very top of the high tower a heart of red crystal hangs on chains, taller than a man, beating slowly. It has to matter to someone very much.
objectives: Break the heart, or leave it beating
stages.hint: Break the Heart of Sorrow at the top of the high tower, or leave it beating.

stages.journal: We broke the heart at the top of the high tower. Whatever wounds it used to take for Strahd, he takes himself now. He felt it break.
